newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan anti-monopoly body raiding NGK Insulators.
newsitem.headline: Japan anti-monopoly body raiding NGK Insulators.

text.p: Japan's antimonopoly watchdog on Thursday conducted a search of the offices of NGK Insulators Ltd, including its headquarters in Nagoya, a company spokesman said.

Officials of Japan's Fair Trade Commission (FTC) are investigating the company for alleged violation of the anti-monopoly law over equipment which coats various machines in order to protect them from corrosion, the spokesman said.
He said he could not comment further on the raid as the investigation had not yet finished,
